content: {"episode_id":"ep-05024","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"This appeal concerns the CO-197 denial of CPT 93229, Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring, for episode ep-05024. The clinical indication note documents that the patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42) in the setting of known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10) and nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Per the indication, mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes. We submit this documentation as the supporting clinical justification of medical necessity invited by the payer letter and request reprocessing of the outstanding balance of 581.63."}
